news.detail: The 31-year-old tight end has appeared in two games this season, securing all three of his targets for 17 yards. The Bengals like to use multiple tight ends, and Hudson played fewer snaps than both Drew Sample and Mike Gesicki but more than Erick All during Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Steelers.

profile: role: TE rotational — 4% of targets, 9% of snaps.
